# IRunningRules.OverspeedDeceleration property

The slowdown above [`RunSpeed`](./RunSpeed.md) without boost, and above [`HighSpeed`](./HighSpeed.md) with it, 300 by default. In the air, it applies above [`MinSpeed`](../ISwingRules/MinSpeed.md).
